messages:
drew: noticing drift across SDKs: some send an "envelope" preface for batched streaming, others stream raw frames. Streaming parsers start failing.
nina: are these only external SDKs or internal too?
drew: internal JS + Python libs both. Happens when gateway coalesces frames.
omar: quick thought: cheap ingress check that peeks first 128 bytes and sets `x-rw-detected-shape`. If envelope -> route to unwrap path; else -> fast path. Low CPU hit.
nina: ok but routing adds hops. Sidecar unwrap gives isolation but increases tail latency. We should quantify p99 delta.
drew: sketch of rule I prototyped:
```
peek = req.body.peek(128)
if peek.startswith("{\"envelope\""):
  set_header("x-rw-detected-shape", "envelope")
elif "batch=1" in req.query:
  set_header("x-rw-detected-shape", "legacy-query")
else:
  set_header("x-rw-detected-shape", "new")
```
omar: telemetry: emit `compat_shape` tag and a `compat_warning` header when legacy shape used. Dashboard should show per-tenant migration curve.
nina: rollout: 1) enable peek+header in staging (2w), 2) canary in prod with small percent, 3) soft warnings for 60 days, 4) announce deprecation.
ops-bot: canary scheduled: ingress-peek-canary to canary cluster at 2026-03-28T04:00:00Z (ticket ARCH-9077)
drew: I'll write the RFC with examples and exact header names. Omar, can you run perf microbench for peek vs sidecar by EOW?
omar: on it. Will paste results.
nina: cool. Meeting tomorrow 9am PT to lock owners and timelines. /remind #architecture tomorrow 9am finalize negotiation"
